name: NC Department of Information Technology

mission.text: Enable business-driven services and solutions that provide a secure and frictionless digital government experience for North Carolinians.

program_priorities: Future-ready government through AI and emerging technologies
Reliable and accessible technology and data services
Statewide IT ecosystem with agencies, counties and community institutions

objectives.goal_title: Reliable and accessible technology and data services
objectives.text: Ensure state services are supported by reliable, accessible technology and data, with transparent IT funding and performance ratings.

objectives.goal_title: Future-ready government through AI and emerging technologies
objectives.text: Set up statewide data governance to advance data quality, accessibility and analytics.

objectives.goal_title: Future-ready government through AI and emerging technologies
objectives.text: Make agencies AI-ready and stand up an AI accelerator for smarter, faster, trusted government operations.

objectives.goal_title: Statewide IT ecosystem with agencies, counties and community institutions
objectives.text: Coordinate with agencies, counties, boards and community institutions to advance cybersecurity and efficiency, reducing application redundancy.
Expand two-way cybersecurity partnerships with federal, state and local partners.
Assess the state's cyber posture, monitor privacy risk and reduce the cyber threat surface through risk management.
Establish IT talent pipelines and entry-level programs for the public-sector IT workforce.

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
